extracted.name: Smoky Four-Pepper Salsa
extracted.description: This quick and easy, smoky four-pepper salsa recipe uses four kinds of peppers, both sweet and hot, and can be adjusted to any degree of heat you like.
ingredient_lines: 1 jalapeno chile pepper, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon mesquite flavored liquid smoke concentrate
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Cook on the preheated grill for 10 minutes; flip. Place poblanos, bell pepper, Anaheims, and jalapeño on the grill; cook 5 to 7 minutes per side.
Transfer tomatoes to a bowl. Place bell pepper, poblanos, Anaheims, and jalapeño in an airtight container. Cool, about 15 minutes.
Peel tomatoes. Drain. Peel and seed peppers.
Combine tomatoes, peppers, onion, cilantro, vinegar, salt, and garlic in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until blended. Add liquid smoke; pulse until salsa reaches desired consistency.
